overview: The Medford Climate Equity Council elected co-chairs and reviewed progress on municipal energy reduction and environmental ordinances. Presentations focused on residential energy incentives, long-term flood projections, and the development of emergency shelter infrastructure.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Approved previous meeting minutes with a request to explicitly list attendee names in the record.

items.title: Selection of Co-Chairs
items.summary: Appointed Charbel Hayek and Lizette as council co-chairs.

items.title: City Action Updates
items.summary: Brenda Pike reported a 20% reduction in municipal emissions since 2009 and updated the council on the city's tree protection ordinances and electric aggregation flexibility.

items.title: EV Infrastructure and Bus Electrification
items.summary: The council reviewed the rollout of public electric vehicle charging stations and discussed a technical assistance grant for electrifying the school bus fleet.

items.title: Mass Save Incentives Deep Dive
items.summary: Pike detailed income-eligible fuel assistance, utility discount rates, and rebates available for heat pumps and home insulation projects.

items.title: Flood Risk and Mitigation
items.summary: The council reviewed maps showing projected flood risks through 2070 and discussed localized infrastructure improvements to manage stormwater and dam maintenance.

items.title: Emergency Shelters and Resilience Hubs
items.summary: Evaluated the status of Medford High School as the primary emergency shelter and discussed plans for a future multi-service resilience hub.
